user_words.value: The user's current utterance exactly as written, with references resolved only from relevant prior context.

user_words.definition: User-authored language is primary instruction evidence; agent summaries never replace it.

user_words.definition_of_evaluation: Compare preserved request text to the actual user utterance and only the context needed to resolve references.

user_words.pass_criteria: The complete user-authored instruction is preserved without controller or agent pollution.

user_words.fail_criteria: The request is truncated, meaningfully normalized, paraphrased as source text, or polluted by non-user text.

effective_instruction_U.value: Resolved user request plus every applicable governing rule.

effective_instruction_U.definition: U is the complete set of requirements, prohibitions, permissions, questions, corrections, limits, and procedural constraints for the turn.

effective_instruction_U.definition_of_evaluation: Construct U from user_words and applicable rules while retaining source traceability.

effective_instruction_U.pass_criteria: Every applicable requirement is represented exactly once at the semantic level and retains its source.

effective_instruction_U.fail_criteria: A requirement is omitted, invented, scope-changed, or replaced by agent interpretation.

agent_response_P.value: The agent's proposed words plus actions and results actually observed.

agent_response_P.definition: P distinguishes intention, attempt, execution, and verified completion.

agent_response_P.definition_of_evaluation: Compare execution-dependent claims to independent live evidence; keep 'will do', 'tried', and 'did' distinct.

agent_response_P.pass_criteria: P states only what live evidence supports and accurately identifies incomplete or failed work.

agent_response_P.fail_criteria: P reports intention/attempt as completion, asserts unobserved state, masks remaining work, or relies on self-report as evidence.

live_ground_truth.value: The freshest authoritative source that directly owns the fact being asserted.

live_ground_truth.definition: Ground truth is obtained from live artifacts, git objects/refs, runtime records, state/message/store records, exact evaluator returns, authoritative application records, or other execution-proximate sources. Memory, prior assistant self-report, generated summaries, plans, and self-asserted evidence are testimony only.

live_ground_truth.definition_of_evaluation: For each material execution-dependent claim identify authority, freshness, execution proximity, specificity, integrity, locator, and exact observed content; compare the claim against that source.

live_ground_truth.pass_criteria: Every material claim is supported by live authoritative evidence or is explicitly classified as UNKNOWN/PARTIAL/NOT_EXECUTED without being represented as success.

live_ground_truth.fail_criteria: A claim outruns its evidence, a contradicted/unknown claim is presented as complete, memory/self-report substitutes for a live source, or a live source is available but not checked.

ground_truth_status.definition: VERIFIED means direct authoritative support; CONTRADICTED means direct conflict; PARTIAL means only part of the claim is supported; UNKNOWN means the authoritative source is unavailable/ambiguous/unresolved; NOT_EXECUTED means live evidence establishes the claimed action did not occur.

ground_truth_status.definition_of_evaluation: Assign exactly one status from live evidence and preserve modifiers/exceptions rather than collapsing qualified claims.

ground_truth_status.pass_criteria: Status matches the evidence and scope of the complete claim.

ground_truth_status.fail_criteria: UNKNOWN/PARTIAL/NOT_EXECUTED is converted into success or a contradiction is ignored.

exact_satisfaction.value: P satisfies U only when every requirement and modifier is met without unauthorized extra work.

exact_satisfaction.definition: Semantic equivalence is allowed only when scope, quantity, method, sequence, target, and prohibitions remain intact.

exact_satisfaction.definition_of_evaluation: Compare P independently against each decomposed requirement and modifier.

exact_satisfaction.pass_criteria: Every requirement passes and no unauthorized action is introduced.

exact_satisfaction.fail_criteria: Any required result is missing, prohibition violated, modifier changed, target changed, or extra work introduced.

shared_configuration_contract_governs_ex.value: All external file dependencies, triggers, runtime roots, and evaluation artifacts are declared in ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json. Specification and runtime refer to named keys in that shared config rather than independently hardcoding external paths.

shared_configuration_contract_governs_ex.definition: External file locations must remain identical between specification and runtime via one shared supervisor configuration.

shared_configuration_contract_governs_ex.definition_of_evaluation: Compare external path references in Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js against the entries in ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json.

shared_configuration_contract_governs_ex.pass_criteria: Both specification and runtime resolve external dependencies from config.json using matching keys.

shared_configuration_contract_governs_ex.fail_criteria: An external file path is hardcoded divergently or bypasses the shared configuration keys.

rule_following.scenario: Step 3 test source is resolved via config.json key external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact.path.
Runtime reads triggerPath from config.json key trigger_file.
Agents.md instructs supervisor to consult the artifact defined under step3_evaluation_artifact in config.json.

rule_breaking.scenario: Runtime hardcodes an external test file path that differs from the path in config.json.
Agents.md specifies a hardcoded path not present in config.json.
Specification and runtime invent different keys for the same file artifact.

return_schema_is_the_exclusive_per_step_.value: Every step has a required return schema; the ChatGPT-owned execution result is persisted and Gemini evaluates that exact schema before advancement. A failed earlier gate cannot be bypassed. return_schema_completed refers only to the current step.

return_schema_is_the_exclusive_per_step_.definition: Per-step return schemas are the canonical execution and gating interface.

return_schema_is_the_exclusive_per_step_.definition_of_evaluation: Check schema shape, required fields, truthfulness, persistence, role ownership, completion semantics, and current-step gate state.

return_schema_is_the_exclusive_per_step_.pass_criteria: The current-step schema is complete, truthful, persisted, produced by the required role, and advances only after PASS.

return_schema_is_the_exclusive_per_step_.fail_criteria: A schema/control requirement is absent/false, a failed step is bypassed, or step completion is misrepresented as whole-procedure completion.

rule_following.scenario: Step 2 is persisted and receives Gemini PASS before Step 3.
Step 3 marks return_schema_completed only after A-G and tests are complete.
A Step 2 FAIL remains at Step 2 for correction.

rule_breaking.scenario: Step 1 omits a required field but the controller advances.
A Step 3 FAIL is followed by Step 4 execution.
return_schema_completed=true is reported as proof that all steps are done.

model_role_separation_and_server_verifie.value: Steps 0-4 are ChatGPT-owned. Supervisory gates are Gemini-owned. Neither role may execute, repair, retry, or simulate the other role's work. role_completed must be supported by runtime/server evidence.

model_role_separation_and_server_verifie.definition: Role ownership is a runtime boundary, not a textual label.

model_role_separation_and_server_verifie.definition_of_evaluation: Compare role_required, role_forbidden, role_completed, and role_verification to observed execution locus.

model_role_separation_and_server_verifie.pass_criteria: Runtime evidence establishes role_completed equals role_required and not role_forbidden.

model_role_separation_and_server_verifie.fail_criteria: Wrong role executed, evidence is missing/conflicting, or output is relabeled to hide origin.

rule_following.scenario: ChatGPT authors the execution return through the connected GitHub tool.
Gemini API produces the supervisory gate inside send-to-gemini.js.
A Gemini-authored Step 2 payload is rejected despite valid JSON.

rule_breaking.scenario: Gemini is asked to generate Step 3 execution content.
A payload self-labels as ChatGPT while runtime provenance shows Gemini.

chatgpt_turn_must_span_every_nonterminal.value: A nextmessage commit creates a mandatory wait for the corresponding Gemini response. On FAIL ChatGPT corrects the same step and recommits. On PASS with remaining work ChatGPT executes the next step. The turn ends only after the latest response and terminal state.

chatgpt_turn_must_span_every_nonterminal.definition: The user-facing turn spans the complete commit-response-control loop.

chatgpt_turn_must_span_every_nonterminal.definition_of_evaluation: Inspect outstanding response state, latest gate, current_step, remaining_steps, and required retry/continuation.

chatgpt_turn_must_span_every_nonterminal.pass_criteria: No outstanding response exists and either continuation occurs or the procedure is terminal.

chatgpt_turn_must_span_every_nonterminal.fail_criteria: The turn ends after a commit, nonterminal PASS, or FAIL without same-step correction.

rule_following.scenario: Step 1 PASS immediately continues to Step 2.
Step 3 FAIL is corrected in the same run.
Step 4 PASS with no remaining steps ends the turn.

rule_breaking.scenario: ChatGPT says committed and ends before Gemini responds.
Step 0 passes but Step 1 is not submitted.
A FAIL is merely reported to the user.

bootstrap_must_create_and_isolate_a_cons.value: Each run has path-safe run_nonce and isolated state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json under runs/<run_nonce>/. Execution and gate records remain in that run.

bootstrap_must_create_and_isolate_a_cons.definition: Bootstrap establishes run identity, persistence, and isolation.

bootstrap_must_create_and_isolate_a_cons.definition_of_evaluation: Verify the three live files, matching nonce values, isolation, initial request persistence, and bootstrap-before-Step-0 order.

bootstrap_must_create_and_isolate_a_cons.pass_criteria: All run-container invariants hold and only the active run is mutated.

bootstrap_must_create_and_isolate_a_cons.fail_criteria: Files are absent, nonce mismatches, another run is mutated, or Step 0 occurs before bootstrap.

rule_following.scenario: All three run files exist with the same nonce.
Retry records remain under the same nonce.
Initial user text is persisted before Step 0 completes.

rule_breaking.scenario: Step 0 writes into another run directory.
A required run file is missing.

live_ground_truth_verification_against_p.value: Before a supervisory PASS on any materially execution-dependent claim, the runtime and supervisor must independently correlate the claim with exact live ground truth. Agent self-report, prior assistant statements, plans, generated summaries, memory, and self-asserted evidence are testimony only and never sufficient ground truth.

live_ground_truth_verification_against_p.definition: Live ground-truth verification prevents fabricated paths, commits, artifacts, evaluator results, execution status, and completion claims from passing because their JSON is syntactically plausible. Ground truth includes current artifact bytes/text, git blobs/commits/refs, runtime/tool records, state/messages/store records, exact evaluator returns, and other authoritative execution-proximate sources.

live_ground_truth_verification_against_p.definition_of_evaluation: Extract material execution-dependent claims; map each to an authoritative live source; retrieve/inspect that source; preserve source and locator plus exact observed content; evaluate authority, freshness, execution proximity, specificity, and integrity; assign VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, or NOT_EXECUTED; resolve conflicts by authority/freshness; never convert UNKNOWN/PARTIAL/NOT_EXECUTED into success.

live_ground_truth_verification_against_p.pass_criteria: Every material completion/execution/artifact claim either has VERIFIED live evidence or is accurately reported as non-verified without implying success. No blocking live-ground-truth finding is ignored by a PASS gate.

live_ground_truth_verification_against_p.fail_criteria: A material claim is accepted from self-report, memory, stale summary, or unverified locator; a live source contradicts the claim; required live evidence is unavailable but success is asserted; a blocking finding is omitted or ignored; or Gemini alters deterministic findings supplied by the runtime.

rule_following.scenario: A claimed commit SHA is checked in the live git object database and exists before the completion claim passes.
Step 4 names a file and content; the runtime reads the live workspace file and confirms the claimed text before Gemini passes it.
The runtime cannot verify a claimed external send, marks it UNKNOWN, and the gate refuses to treat it as completed.

rule_breaking.scenario: The agent says 'I committed it' and Gemini passes solely because completion_evidence contains that sentence.
A file locator does not exist in the live workspace but the gate returns PASS.
Gemini rewrites a deterministic finding from CONTRADICTED to VERIFIED.

step_four_reporting_must_put_failures_an.value: Step 4 reports failed actions first, incomplete actions second, and only verified completed actions last; every completion requires granular evidence.

step_four_reporting_must_put_failures_an.definition: Final reporting order prevents partial work from being hidden behind completion language.

step_four_reporting_must_put_failures_an.definition_of_evaluation: Compare actual plan/requirements and live evidence to failed_actions, not_completed_actions, and completed_actions.

step_four_reporting_must_put_failures_an.pass_criteria: Every failure/incomplete item is represented first and every completion is live-ground-truth VERIFIED.

step_four_reporting_must_put_failures_an.fail_criteria: A failure/incomplete item is omitted or a completion lacks verified evidence.

dependency_chart.decision: load external file references and runtime path configuration
select or create isolated run container
validate current-step schema and extract material execution-dependent claims
constrain Step 3 planning and Step 4 final coverage
supply evaluation_heuristic and complete Step3_TSR tests to Step 3
any T repeats Step 3; all F permits Step 3 completion
reject malformed/altered findings and prevent PASS when blocking findings exist
PASS advances exactly one step; FAIL remains on same step

instruction.definition_of_evaluation: Must require semantic and live-ground-truth evaluation and forbid ChatGPT-step execution/repair.

instruction.fail_criteria: Wrong-role execution permitted or required checks omitted.

granular_evaluation.definition_of_evaluation: Every terminal execution key/value must be preserved exactly and evaluated.

ground_truth_verification_eval.definition: Supervisor evaluation of immutable deterministic live-ground-truth findings.

ground_truth_verification_eval.definition_of_evaluation: Preserve runtime findings and aggregate status exactly; independently evaluate every finding; blocking findings prohibit PASS.

ground_truth_verification_eval.pass_criteria: Exact preservation, complete evaluations, and no blocking finding ignored.

ground_truth_verification_eval.fail_criteria: Findings altered/omitted, evaluation incomplete, or PASS despite blocking evidence.

step_level_evaluation.definition_of_evaluation: Aggregate all schema, requirement, role, and ground-truth checks.

failures.definition_of_evaluation: Every detected independent failure must be represented separately.

gate_result.definition_of_evaluation: PASS only when every required component passes and no blocking live-ground-truth finding exists.

start_of_turn.return_schema_completed.definition_of_evaluation: True only with complete Step 0 return.

evaluation_requirements.value: Preserve complete user utterance.
Use active run/request identifiers.
Verify bootstrap/run identity claims from the live run-container files; self-asserted role/run evidence is testimony until correlated with runtime findings.

evaluation_requirements.definition_of_evaluation: Use deterministic live ground-truth findings plus role provenance.

evaluation_requirements.pass_criteria: Required live files and identity claims are VERIFIED and no blocking finding exists.

evaluation_requirements.fail_criteria: Run/role claim contradicted, unknown but asserted successful, or deterministic finding ignored.

evaluation_requirements.value: Persist execution/gate records and receive PASS before Step 1.

evaluation_requirements.definition_of_evaluation: Inspect live run records and gate.

supervisory_gate.instruction: Evaluate Step 0 only; correlate execution-dependent claims with immutable runtime ground-truth findings; preserve all *_eval values; do not execute/repair the ChatGPT step.

evaluation_requirements.value: Preserve complete Step 0 request and identifiers.
Use verified ChatGPT role, complete/persist Step 1, and receive PASS before Step 2.

supervisory_gate.instruction: Evaluate Step 1 only and preserve every terminal execution key/value; do not execute/repair the ChatGPT step.

evaluation_requirements.value: Extract all and only user-stated requirements verbatim.

evaluation_requirements.definition_of_evaluation: Compare each entry to user words and full coverage.

evaluation_requirements.value: Any claim that a prior requirement, artifact, evaluator result, or execution state exists must be correlated with live run/artifact sources rather than memory/self-report.

evaluation_requirements.definition_of_evaluation: Use deterministic runtime findings for execution-dependent source claims.

evaluation_requirements.pass_criteria: Material source-state claims VERIFIED or accurately non-verified.

evaluation_requirements.fail_criteria: Unverified source-state assertion is accepted as fact.

evaluation_requirements.value: Use verified ChatGPT role, complete/persist Step 2, and receive PASS before Step 3.

supervisory_gate.instruction: Evaluate Step 2 only; verify verbatim requirement coverage and correlate any execution-dependent source claims with immutable runtime ground truth; preserve all *_eval values; do not execute/repair the ChatGPT step.

Step_3.definition_of_evaluation: Require complete A-G plus control fields.

Step_3.A.definition_of_evaluation: Compare U value to Step 0 user request.

Step_3.B.definition_of_evaluation: Compare to U and Step 2 requirements.

Step_3.C.definition_of_evaluation: Each modifier includes meaning_without_modifier, difference, recursive_level.

Step_3.D.definition_of_evaluation: Map every Step 2 requirement without unauthorized work.

Step_3.E.definition: Proposed final report if plan is executed and verified.

Step_3.F.definition: Every active test is independently evaluated.

Step_3.F.definition_of_evaluation: Compare Test_Count and test results against the canonical evaluation artifact defined in config.json under external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact.

Step_3.G.definition: Any T repeats Step 3; all F completes planning.

Step_3.return_schema_completed.definition_of_evaluation: True only when A-G complete and all tests F.

evaluation_requirements.value: Preserve U and fully decompose clauses/actions/persons/objects/modifiers.
P satisfies every Step 2 requirement without unauthorized additions or changed modifiers.
Evaluate every active Step3_TSR test independently.

evaluation_requirements.definition_of_evaluation: Compare test count and results to the canonical Step 3 evaluation artifact resolved via config.json key external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact.path.

evaluation_requirements.value: Any assertion that a referenced file, test source, repository state, evaluator result, or prior execution record exists or has stated content must be correlated with deterministic live ground truth before PASS.

evaluation_requirements.definition_of_evaluation: Compare Step 3 source/evidence claims with runtime findings.

evaluation_requirements.pass_criteria: Material claims VERIFIED or accurately non-verified and not used as successful premises.

evaluation_requirements.fail_criteria: Fabricated/stale/unknown source claim supports the plan or blocking finding is ignored.

evaluation_requirements.value: Any T repeats Step 3 from A; all F permits completion.
Use verified ChatGPT role, complete/persist Step 3, receive Gemini PASS, then proceed to implementation/Step 4.

supervisory_gate.instruction: Evaluate Step 3 only using Agents.md, Step 2 requirements, the canonical evaluation artifact resolved from config.json (external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact), and immutable runtime ground truth; preserve all *_eval values/findings; do not execute/repair the ChatGPT step.

Step_4.failed_actions.definition: Failed actions with failure, remaining work, evidence.

Step_4.failed_actions.definition_of_evaluation: Compare actual execution and live evidence.

Step_4.not_completed_actions.pass_criteria: Every incomplete action represented before completion.

Step_4.completed_actions.definition: Only fully completed actions with granular completion_evidence.

Step_4.completed_actions.definition_of_evaluation: Every claim must be independently live-ground-truth verified.

Step_4.completed_actions.pass_criteria: Every completion VERIFIED and correctly ordered.

Step_4.return_schema_completed.definition_of_evaluation: True only when report is complete and truthful.

evaluation_requirements.value: Report every failed action first with remaining work and evidence.
Report every partial/incomplete action after failures and before completions.
Every completed action and every material execution/artifact claim must be independently VERIFIED against live authoritative sources before it can appear as completed.

evaluation_requirements.definition_of_evaluation: Correlate completion_evidence source/locator/observed_content with immutable deterministic findings; self-reported evidence alone is insufficient.

evaluation_requirements.pass_criteria: All material completion claims are VERIFIED and deterministic findings are preserved/evaluated; no blocking finding exists.

evaluation_requirements.fail_criteria: Any completed claim is CONTRADICTED/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN/NOT_EXECUTED, any locator is fabricated/unverified, or blocking evidence is ignored.

evaluation_requirements.value: Account for every Step 2 requirement and the executed Step 3 plan.

evaluation_requirements.definition_of_evaluation: Map each requirement to failed/incomplete/completed evidence.

evaluation_requirements.value: Use verified role, complete/persist Step 4, and end only after Gemini PASS with no remaining steps.

evaluation_requirements.fail_criteria: Any fail or turn ends with outstanding work/response.

supervisory_gate.instruction: Evaluate Step 4 only; independently verify all material execution/completion/artifact claims from immutable deterministic ground truth; preserve all *_eval values/findings; failures first, incomplete second, verified completion last; do not execute/repair the ChatGPT step.

shared_configuration_contract.value: All external references are resolved via ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json.

shared_configuration_contract.definition: Neither Agents.md nor send-to-gemini.js independently hardcodes divergent external file paths.

shared_configuration_contract.definition_of_evaluation: Inspect active configuration references against config.json keys.

shared_configuration_contract.pass_criteria: Both files use the matching config keys.

agents_md_is_canonical_evaluation_source.value: Agents.md contains all active evaluation definitions and pass/fail criteria.

agents_md_is_canonical_evaluation_source.definition: No external evaluation-definition file is required.

agents_md_is_canonical_evaluation_source.definition_of_evaluation: Inspect active prompts/source for external definition dependencies.

deterministic_live_ground_truth_precedes.value: send-to-gemini.js independently inspects live workspace/git/run records before Gemini evaluates execution-dependent claims.

deterministic_live_ground_truth_precedes.definition: Empirical evidence is supplied by the runtime, not invented by the model.

deterministic_live_ground_truth_precedes.definition_of_evaluation: Inspect collectGroundTruth output, system prompt injection, gate template, validator, and persisted records.

deterministic_live_ground_truth_precedes.pass_criteria: Findings are generated before supervision, immutable in the gate, structurally required, persisted, and blocking when material.

deterministic_live_ground_truth_precedes.fail_criteria: Supervisor sees only self-claims, findings are mutable/optional, or PASS can ignore blocking evidence.

ground_truth_findings_are_persisted.value: Every attempt persists deterministic findings in state step_records and store records.

ground_truth_findings_are_persisted.definition: Historical execution claims remain auditable from verbatim evidence.

ground_truth_findings_are_persisted.pass_criteria: Exact findings persisted with the evaluated execution.

transition_semantics_are_unchanged.value: supervisory_gate.gate_result remains the exact transition key; PASS advances one step and FAIL retries the same step.

transition_semantics_are_unchanged.definition: Ground-truth enforcement strengthens gates without changing procedure control semantics.

step_3_evaluation_artifact_is_canonical.value: The artifact referenced in config.json as step3_evaluation_artifact provides the active evaluation heuristic and complete Step3_TSR question corpus as one parsed JSON object.

step_3_evaluation_artifact_is_canonical.definition: Step 3 uses the combined JSON evaluation artifact without duplicating it into Agents.md and without tracking document reads.

step_3_evaluation_artifact_is_canonical.definition_of_evaluation: Inspect config key external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact, runtime loading, and Step 3 context files.

step_3_evaluation_artifact_is_canonical.pass_criteria: Artifact loaded via shared config; evaluation_heuristic and step3_tsr used together; no evaluation_documents_read tracking field.

step_3_evaluation_artifact_is_canonical.fail_criteria: Artifact unavailable, split divergently, or read tracking reintroduced.
